mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(ps.category_id, p.category_id) AS categoryId, COUNT(*) AS productCount FROM ck_shop_product_store ps INNER JOIN ck_shop_product p ON p.id = ps.product_id AND p.del_flag = 0 WHERE ps.del_flag = 0 AND ps.store_id = #{storeId} AND ps.status = 'Y' AND p.status = 'Y' GROUP BY COALESCE(ps.category_id, p.category_id)
